## Summary

Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd (policy CC-1703): theft of a laptop and an external drive from a locked storage unit at a university library. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 4,732 dollars. The file does not give the date of the theft, which should be confirmed before payment (see Coverage analysis).

## Facts

Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd reported the loss on 26 September 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a university library [notice of loss]. The items are a laptop and an external drive [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 28 September 2026, reference CR/2026/4247 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The date of the theft itself is not stated in the file [notice of loss], [police report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy].

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: the items were in a locked storage unit, which is a locked container [police report], [policy].

Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the loss is a theft, and no gradual deterioration is claimed [notice of loss], [policy].

Exclusion 7.5 does not appear to apply: the police report was made on 28 September 2026, two days after the notice of loss on 26 September 2026 [police report], [notice of loss]. The clause requires a police report within seven days [policy], but the file does not state the date of the theft, so the seven-day period cannot be measured from the loss itself. The date of the theft should be confirmed with the insured before payment.

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted, subject to confirming the date of the theft for exclusion 7.5.

## Reserve

The reserve is 4,732 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (2,603 dollars and 2,129 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No schedule showing an excess is in the file, so under clause 9.1 none applies [policy].
